ops.title: cc-vigil hardware E2E playbook (moved)
ops.body: The playbook moved to the cc-vigil repo's own cc-notes store, where the repo's README Verification section points: in /Users/yasyf/Code/cc-vigil (github.com/yasyf/cc-vigil), run cc-notes doc list and open doc 4c052ee ("cc-vigil hardware E2E playbook"). Its companion checklist task there is cd9ec31. It originally landed in this repo's store by accident of session cwd.
ops.when: Running or planning the on-hardware acceptance drills for cc-vigil, or answering how to manually verify a cc-vigil release.
